# Vincent van Gogh – The Letters (TEI XML)

Source XML for the scholarly edition at https://vangoghletters.org/
(Van Gogh Museum & Huygens ING, eds. Leo Jansen, Hans Luijten, Nienke Bakker, 2009).

- Copied from https://github.com/eeditiones/vangogh (`data/`), commit
  9e75f58a618a761e39c88bd84cf6e1e72e4e0390 (2023-11-25). Files carry SVN dates up to 2018.
- The edition also publishes an official zip (http://vangoghletters.org/vg/vangoghxml.zip,
  per the site's "About this edition" page), which may be newer; not yet compared.
- License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Treat as read-only; corrections belong in data overrides.

`let001`–`let902`: letters. `RM01`–`RM25`: related manuscripts. `people.xml`: person index.
`taxonomy.xml` is a TEI Publisher demo file, not part of the edition.
